生成された動画：=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:
Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

This scene takes place during a catastrophic battle after Riven has already become an experienced warrior.

Her original character design must remain unchanged, but she is now physically exhausted and battle-worn.

Add only temporary battle-state details naturally caused by the current fight: dust and ash on her skin and clothing, messy hair, subtle scratches, minor damage to clothing and armor, and restrained traces of blood on her face.

Do not redesign her costume.
Do not change her hairstyle.
Do not change her body proportions.
Do not replace or redesign her sword.

Riven's physical performance should communicate that she is highly trained but currently exhausted, injured, confused, and emotionally overwhelmed.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.

No dialogue from adult Riven in this scene.

=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.
Natural human movement.
Grounded physical interaction.
Realistic sword weight and metal physics.
Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict facial identity, costume consistency, sword consistency, and body proportions throughout the whole video.

The environment is a poor medieval-fantasy village being destroyed during a battle at night.

Wooden houses are burning.
Thick smoke moves through the streets.
Ash and glowing embers drift through the air.
Firelight creates warm orange illumination through otherwise dark blue-gray smoke.

The battlefield should feel chaotic in the distance but visually controlled around Riven.

Do not clearly reveal who is attacking the village.

Enemy soldiers may exist only as indistinct silhouettes, shadows, distant movement, or partially obscured figures.

Do not clearly show military insignia, recognizable uniforms, faces, banners, or faction symbols.

The audience must NOT yet understand who attacked Riven or why the village is burning.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Use restrained handheld movement during moments of physical struggle, but keep Riven clearly readable.

Avoid excessive cuts.
Avoid rapid montage.
Avoid exaggerated slow motion.
Avoid supernatural movement.
Avoid flashy magical effects.

No subtitles.
No captions.
No visible text during the scene.
No watermark.
No logo.

Audio:
roaring fire,
burning wood cracking,
distant screams,
distant metal impacts,
heavy footsteps,
wind moving through smoke,
falling debris,
Riven's exhausted breathing,
realistic sword impacts.

No background music during most of the sequence.

Allow the soundscape to become increasingly muted near the end before the child's remembered voice is heard.

=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open the film in the middle of an unexplained catastrophe.

Riven is already on the ground in a burning village.

The audience receives no explanation of what happened before this moment.

Her sword lies just beyond her reach.

Riven struggles across the dirt and reaches for it.

Despite her exhaustion, she refuses to remain down.

She grabs the sword and forces herself back onto her feet.

Through smoke and fire, an unidentified attacker approaches.

Never clearly reveal the attacker's identity.

Riven barely has enough time to raise her sword defensively.

A powerful weapon strike crashes against her blade.

The impact violently fractures the sword.

A large piece of the broken blade spins away and falls onto the ground.

Riven is thrown backward by the force and collapses again.

She looks toward something happening deeper inside the burning village.

Do NOT reveal what she sees.

Her expression changes from physical pain to shock and emotional devastation.

The chaotic battlefield audio gradually becomes distant and muffled.

Over the image, we hear the remembered voice of CHILD RIVEN asking her father:

"Father... are warriors the strongest people?"

The voice should sound like a genuine memory: a young girl around ten to twelve years old, soft, curious, innocent, natural, and emotionally neutral.

Do not show child Riven yet.

End on the broken sword lying in the dirt as firelight reflects across the fractured metal.

The audience should leave the opening with three unanswered questions:

What happened to the village?
Who is fighting Riven?
Why did her sword break?

=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — THE REACH

Extreme low-angle close-up almost at ground level.

Riven's sword lies in the dirt in the foreground.

Ash and glowing embers fall around it.

In the blurred middle ground, Riven lies several feet away after having been knocked down.

The burning village fills the distant background.

Riven breathes heavily.

She plants one hand into the dirt and reaches toward the sword with the other.

Her fingertips initially fail to reach the handle.

She drags herself slightly forward.

Keep the camera low and intimate.

Do not reveal any attacker.

Hold enough time for the audience to register Riven's exhaustion.

CUT.


Shot 2 — SHE STILL GETS UP

Close-up on Riven's hand finally wrapping firmly around the sword handle.

She pulls the weapon toward herself.

Transition naturally into a medium shot as Riven uses the sword and one leg to push herself upright.

Her movement is difficult and physically believable.

She briefly loses balance but refuses to fall.

Behind her, wooden buildings burn through thick smoke.

Riven finally stands.

She is exhausted, breathing heavily, but still gripping the sword.

Do not make the pose heroic.

She is surviving, not posing.

CUT.


Shot 3 — SOMETHING APPROACHES

Medium close-up on Riven.

A heavy metallic footstep or weapon sound is heard somewhere through the smoke ahead of her.

Riven slowly raises her eyes.

Her expression becomes alert.

Camera moves slightly behind Riven's shoulder.

Through dense smoke and firelight, show only the vague silhouette of an approaching human figure.

The figure must remain visually anonymous.

No readable face.
No readable armor design.
No insignia.
No faction information.

Riven tightens her grip on the sword.

Another step.

The silhouette suddenly accelerates toward her.

CUT.


Shot 4 — THE BREAK

Dynamic medium shot.

The unidentified attacker enters only partially into frame and delivers one extremely powerful weapon strike.

Keep the attacker obscured by framing, smoke, motion, and backlighting.

Riven instinctively raises her sword with both hands to block.

CLANG.

The weapons collide with heavy physical force.

For a brief instant, Riven holds the strike.

Then:

CRACK.

A visible fracture travels through Riven's blade.

The upper section of the sword snaps away.

The broken metal fragment rotates through the air.

Use a very brief cinematic slowdown only for the broken blade fragment.

Firelight reflects across the spinning metal.

Immediately return to normal speed.

The impact throws Riven backward.

CUT.


Shot 5 — WHAT DOES SHE SEE?

Riven hits the ground hard.

The remaining broken sword slips partly from her hand.

Camera moves into a close-up on Riven.

She initially reacts to physical pain.

Then she hears something from deeper inside the village.

Her eyes move toward the sound.

Her expression changes.

Pain becomes disbelief.

Disbelief becomes quiet devastation.

Do NOT reveal what she sees.

Do not cut to her point of view.

Hold entirely on Riven's reaction.

The surrounding sounds of battle slowly become distant and muffled.

Fire remains visible behind her.

Then, over the image, CHILD RIVEN'S remembered voice is heard softly:

"Father... are warriors the strongest people?"

Adult Riven remains completely silent.

CUT.


Shot 6 — THE BROKEN SWORD

Extreme close-up.

The broken section of Riven's sword falls into the dirt.

CLANG.

The metal settles.

Small embers land around it.

Fire from the burning village reflects across the fractured edge.

Riven is visible only as a heavily blurred figure in the distant background.

Hold on the broken sword.

Almost all battlefield sound disappears.

Only distant fire remains.

Do not reveal the attacker.

Do not reveal what happened to the village.

End on the broken blade.

CUT TO BLACK.

=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

The opening ends with the broken section of Riven's sword lying in the dirt.

Riven remains alive but emotionally devastated somewhere behind it.

The identity of the attacker remains completely unknown.

The reason the village is burning remains unknown.

The audience has heard Child Riven's voice for the first time but has not yet seen her.

After this video, the film transitions into Chapter 1, many years earlier.

The next scene begins in the same village while it is still peaceful.

Young Riven lives there with her father.

A visual transition may connect the broken sword from the cold open with an intact old sword in her father's home.

=== MOOD ===

The opening should feel tragic, mysterious, intimate, and restrained rather than like a conventional action opening.

Riven is clearly a capable warrior, but the scene deliberately begins at a moment when strength is no longer enough.

Do not explain the conflict.

Do not glorify the battle.

Do not reveal the tragedy yet.

The broken sword is the central visual symbol.

The emotional progression should be:

confusion
→ physical struggle
→ determination to stand
→ unseen threat
→ violent impact
→ sword breaking
→ shock
→ childhood memory
→ mystery.

The audience should immediately want to understand how the young girl they are about to meet eventually becomes the broken warrior shown here.、16:9
